Subject: Post-call: lock next technical review slot + preferred bridge

Hi Alex / Patricia,

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning — appreciated the clarity on your latency targets and the multi-region constraints for PHI-enclaved traffic. Quick recap and a couple of concrete next steps so we can lock the technical review: 

- What we heard: 1) need to validate model latency at 512-token tail latencies, 2) KV-cache behavior across sessions, 3) deployment options for VPC/private plane.
- Goal for next meeting: 45–60 minute technical deep dive with Soojin (SE) to review a short perf run and network/security checklist.

Proposed slots (I included timezone conversions for PST/ET/CET):
- Tue Jun 1, 10:00–11:00 PT / 13:00–14:00 ET
- Tue Jun 1, 14:00–15:00 PT / 17:00–18:00 ET
- Wed Jun 2, 09:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET

We can run this over Zoom or Google Meet — we generally prefer Google Meet for easier calendar federations with private domains, but happy to send a Zoom link if your org prefers that. Please confirm:
1) which slot works for you (or share two windows that work)
2) preferred bridge (Google Meet or Zoom)
3) attendee list / roles (example: Alex — engineering lead; Patricia — security/compliance)

I attached the raw discovery notes and a suggested agenda for the technical review to keep things focused. Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and the bridge.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
